title: Let the footer of short pages stop at the bottom
goal: Use vertical Flex and minimum height to let the text occupy the remaining space.
summary: Some pages have very short text and want the footer to be at the bottom of the viewport. When the text becomes longer, let the footer naturally follow the text.
tasks: Set the body to a vertical Flex container with a minimum height of 100vh.
Let main fill the excess height after allocation, and the footer maintains normal document flow.

example.code:
.shell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh; }
.content { flex: 1; }
example.note: The main body fills the remaining space and the footer can be pushed below. min-height allows long content to continue to stretch the page.

hint: The body here is the outermost layer, and main is the item that needs to be grown.
